configuration.title: Elisa
configuration.languageServer.path.descri: Path to the elisa-lsp executable. Supports an absolute path, a path relative to the first workspace folder, or a leading ~ for the home directory. When empty, the extension checks ELISA_LSP, a nearby Elisa-LSP build (trusted workspaces only), and PATH.
configuration.trace.server.description: Protocol trace level for the Elisa language server. 'verbose' can include source code; enable only for temporary diagnostics and disable when finished.
